(function () {
  const old = document.getElementById("xb-draw-capture-panel");
  if (old) old.remove();

  let orig = null;
  let checkTimer = null;
  const TARGET = "chat-completions/generate";
  const PANEL_ID = "xb-draw-capture-panel";

  // ── 检测：当前任务是否被禁用 ──
  function isMyTaskDisabled() {
    try {
      if (window.isXiaobaixEnabled === false) return true;
      var cb = document.getElementById("scheduled_tasks_enabled");
      if (cb && !cb.checked) return true;
      if (typeof taskContext !== "undefined" && taskContext && taskContext.taskName) {
        var hit = window.XBTasks && window.XBTasks.find(taskContext.taskName);
        if (hit && hit.task && hit.task.disabled) return true;
      }
      return false;
    } catch (e) {
      return false;
    }
  }

  // ── 提取思维链 ──
  function extractReasoning(data) {
    return (
      data?.choices?.[0]?.delta?.reasoning_content ||
      data?.choices?.[0]?.delta?.reasoning ||
      data?.choices?.[0]?.message?.reasoning_content ||
      data?.choices?.[0]?.message?.reasoning ||
      ""
    );
  }

  function extractContent(data) {
    return (
      data?.choices?.[0]?.delta?.content ||
      data?.choices?.[0]?.message?.content ||
      data?.choices?.[0]?.text ||
      data?.content ||
      ""
    );
  }

  function start() {
    if (orig) return;
    orig = window.fetch;
    window.fetch = function (...args) {
      const url = String(args[0] || "");
      if (!url.includes(TARGET)) return orig.apply(this, args);
      const p = orig.apply(this, args);
      return p.then((r) => {
        r.clone()
          .text()
          .then((t) => {
            window.__lastDrawRaw = t;
            try {
              // ── 非流式响应 ──
              const j = JSON.parse(t);
              const reasoning = extractReasoning(j);
              const content = extractContent(j);
              window.__lastDrawReasoning = reasoning || "";
              window.__lastDrawContent = reasoning
                ? reasoning + "\n\n" + content
                : content;
            } catch {
              // ── 流式 SSE 响应 ──
              const matches = [...t.matchAll(/^data:\s*(.+)$/gm)];
              let reasoningAcc = "";
              const texts = matches
                .map((m) => {
                  try {
                    const d = JSON.parse(m[1]);
                    const reasoning = extractReasoning(d);
                    const content = extractContent(d);
                    if (reasoning) reasoningAcc += reasoning;
                    return reasoning + content;
                  } catch {
                    return "";
                  }
                })
                .filter(Boolean);
              window.__lastDrawReasoning = reasoningAcc;
              window.__lastDrawContent = texts.join("");
            }
          })
          .catch(() => {});
        return r;
      });
    };
  }

  function stop() {
    if (!orig) return;
    window.fetch = orig;
    orig = null;
  }

  function cleanup(reason) {
    if (reason) console.log("%c[Draw Capture] " + reason, "color:#f87171");
    stop();
    if (checkTimer !== null) {
      clearInterval(checkTimer);
      checkTimer = null;
    }
    try {
      var panel = document.getElementById(PANEL_ID);
      if (panel) panel.remove();
    } catch (e) {}
  }

  async function copyToClipboard() {
    const c = window.__lastDrawContent;
    if (!c) {
      icon.textContent = "❌";
      setTimeout(() => { icon.textContent = "📋"; }, 1500);
      return;
    }
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(c);
    } catch {
      const ta = document.createElement("textarea");
      ta.value = c;
      ta.style.cssText = "position:fixed;left:-9999px";
      document.body.appendChild(ta);
      ta.select();
      document.execCommand("copy");
      document.body.removeChild(ta);
    }
    icon.textContent = "✅";
    setTimeout(() => { icon.textContent = "📋"; }, 1500);
  }

  // ── UI：单图标 ──
  const isMobile = window.matchMedia("(max-width: 1000px)").matches;
  const size = isMobile ? "36px" : "28px";
  const fontSize = isMobile ? "22px" : "17px";

  const panel = document.createElement("div");
  panel.id = PANEL_ID;
  panel.style.cssText = [
    "position:fixed",
    "top:8px",
    "right:12px",
    "z-index:2000000",
    "width:" + size,
    "height:" + size,
    "border-radius:50%",
    "background:rgba(20,20,28,0.85)",
    "border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2)",
    "box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.45)",
    "display:flex",
    "align-items:center",
    "justify-content:center",
    "cursor:grab",
    "user-select:none",
    "touch-action:none",
    "transition:transform 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s",
  ].join(";");

  const icon = document.createElement("span");
  icon.textContent = "📋";
  icon.style.cssText = "font-size:" + fontSize + ";line-height:1;pointer-events:none;";
  panel.appendChild(icon);

  // ── 拖动 ──
  let isDragging = false,
    hasMoved = false,
    startX = 0,
    startY = 0,
    panelStartLeft = 0,
    panelStartTop = 0;

  panel.addEventListener("pointerdown", (e) => {
    isDragging = true;
    hasMoved = false;
    startX = e.clientX;
    startY = e.clientY;
    panel.style.cursor = "grabbing";
    panel.style.transform = "scale(1.1)";
    panel.style.boxShadow = "0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.55)";

    const rect = panel.getBoundingClientRect();
    panel.style.top = rect.top + "px";
    panel.style.right = "auto";
    panel.style.left = rect.left + "px";
    panel.style.bottom = "auto";
    panelStartLeft = rect.left;
    panelStartTop = rect.top;

    document.addEventListener("pointermove", onMove);
    document.addEventListener("pointerup", onUp);
    e.preventDefault();
  });

  function onMove(e) {
    if (!isDragging) return;
    const dx = e.clientX - startX;
    const dy = e.clientY - startY;
    if (Math.abs(dx) > 3 || Math.abs(dy) > 3) hasMoved = true;
    panel.style.left = (panelStartLeft + dx) + "px";
    panel.style.top = (panelStartTop + dy) + "px";
  }

  function onUp(e) {
    isDragging = false;
    panel.style.cursor = "grab";
    panel.style.transform = "";
    panel.style.boxShadow = "";
    document.removeEventListener("pointermove", onMove);
    document.removeEventListener("pointerup", onUp);
    if (!hasMoved) copyToClipboard();
  }

  document.body.appendChild(panel);
  start();

  // ── 轮询 ──
  checkTimer = setInterval(() => {
    if (isMyTaskDisabled()) {
      cleanup("检测到当前任务已禁用，自动关闭");
    }
  }, 2000);

  // ── abort ──
  if (typeof abortSignal !== "undefined" && abortSignal) {
    abortSignal.addEventListener("abort", () => {
      if (isMyTaskDisabled()) {
        cleanup("任务被中止，自动关闭");
      }
    });
  }

  console.log(
    "%c[Draw Capture] 📋 已启动 (" + (isMobile ? "移动端" : "桌面端") + ")",
    "color:#3ecf8e"
  );
})();
